long_biography.plain_text:
Dutch entrepreneur Michel Perridon's interest in Bugatti grew from owning a Veyron into collecting the work of the wider family. Alongside historic and modern cars, he acquired Carlo Bugatti's furniture and Rembrandt Bugatti's sculptures. Pieces from his collection were exhibited at the Bugatti festival in Molsheim, bringing the family's art and automotive history together.

In Rotterdam, he established the Leef je Uit Foundation to help older residents overcome loneliness through outings and entertainment. Its partnership with Rotterdam World Gateway supported an annual Christmas gala. Guests were brought together by neighbourhood so they could meet people living nearby. Volunteers and transport helped them take part in an evening they might otherwise have been unable to afford.
